params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $HOME 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
git -C $repo fetch origin main --prune | Out-Null
$sha=(git -C $repo rev-parse origin/main).Trim()
$wt=Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridge\uia-diag'
if(Test-Path $wt){git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null|Out-Null}
git -C $repo worktree add --detach $wt $sha | Out-Null
try{
 $src=Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\uia.ps1'
 $diag=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'heaven-uia-diag.ps1'
 $text=Get-Content -Raw $src
 $text=$text.Replace("Emit-Error 'UIA_BACKEND_ERROR' 'Windows UI Automation operation failed' @{ type = $_.Exception.GetType().FullName }","Emit-Error 'UIA_BACKEND_ERROR' 'Windows UI Automation operation failed' @{ type = $_.Exception.GetType().FullName; exception_message = $_.Exception.Message; position = $_.InvocationInfo.PositionMessage }")
 Set-Content -LiteralPath $diag -Value $text -Encoding UTF8
 $form=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'heaven-uia-diag-form.ps1'
 @'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
$f=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Form
$f.Text='Heaven UIA Diagnostic'
$f.Width=420;$f.Height=180
$t=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TextBox;$t.AccessibleName='Smoke Input';$t.Left=20;$t.Top=20;$t.Width=340
$b=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button;$b.AccessibleName='Close Smoke';$b.Text='Close Smoke';$b.Left=20;$b.Top=65;$b.Width=120
$f.Controls.Add($t);$f.Controls.Add($b)
[System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run($f)
'@|Set-Content -LiteralPath $form -Encoding UTF8
 $p=Start-Process powershell.exe -PassThru -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-Sta','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$form)
 try{
   Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
   $req=@{operation='uia_tree';pid=$p.Id;first_match=$true;max_nodes=120;max_depth=6;wait_ms=0;scope='descendants';include_root=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
   $env:HEAVEN_UIA_REQUEST=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($req))
   Write-Output ('FORM_PID='+$p.Id)
   & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $diag
 }finally{
   try{if(-not $p.HasExited){Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}}catch{}
   Remove-Item $diag,$form -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
 }
}finally{
 git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null|Out-Null
 git -C $repo worktree prune
}
